data_fields.name: smooth_off_value
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 turns the smooth drain off and sets HP at once

data_fields.name: drain_steps_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: steps = MAX(loser HP at start, winner HP loss)

data_fields.name: burst_frame_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: explosion frame time = step time (timing_sec / sprite_count)

data_fields.name: burst_sprite_count
data_fields.donor_constant: sprite count from the tileset (value not read)

data_fields.name: immediate_hold_steps
data_fields.donor_constant: 2 x step per explosion frame on the immediate branch

best_idea: Play the damage as a tween from the server's start HP to its end HP over a number of steps set by the larger HP change, and queue the death burst after it, so the on-screen numbers always land on the server's values.
decision_why: Take the queued tween (both bars share one step count and the death burst waits for the drain); reject the random per-point interleave for duels because it draws client-side randomness, so a replay would show a different sequence from the same server result.
acceptance: A duel hit that takes a fighter from 30 to 0 while the attacker goes from 40 to 35 plays a 30-step bar drain at 10 ms per step (example numbers only), then the death burst on the fighter's tile, and the bars end on the packet's values; a server test asserts the damage packet carries start and end HP for both fighters and the kill flag.
